name: smith-agent
description: Windows-first POC for a local assistant agent

scripts.ui: pnpm run ui:css && bun run src/cli.ts --ui
scripts.build:windows: pnpm run ui:css && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/smith-windows-x64.exe
scripts.build:targets: pnpm run ui:css && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/smith-windows-x64.exe && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/smith-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/smith-darwin-arm64
scripts.ui:build: pnpm run ui:css && bun build src/web/index.html --outdir dist/ui
scripts.ui:verify: pnpm run ui:css && bun run src/web/prototype/verify.ts
